system.notes:
Much larger brain mole. Can smell magic-users. Able to telepathically connect with moles and swap intellects in and out of minions.

AC 11, HP 14, ATK 1 bite -2 (1 + brain exchange + spell drain), MV near (burrow), S -3, D +1, C +1, I -1, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 3

Brain Exchange. If monarch bites mortal, WIS 12+ or swap the target's mind with the mind of a brain mole within psychic gestalt for 1d4 hours. If the brain mole's body is killed, target returns to their normal body.

Psychic Gestalt. Create a hive mind of all brain moles within far, with monarch as leader. Share knowledge and senses.

Spell Drain. Attach to bitten target; auto-hit the next round. Each round, target loses the ability to cast a random spell, regaining spells after resting. STR 9+ on turn to remove.
